about.body: We're an independent café on the canal in Hebden Bridge. We serve breakfasts, sourdough toasties and cakes baked fresh each morning. We wanted a place where everyone feels welcome, muddy boots, dogs and prams included. Come and settle in by the water.

heading.text: How a visit to Bramble and Bean works

steps.lead: Finding us and settling in is simple. Here's what to expect when you visit.

items.title: Find us by the canal
items.body: We're easy to spot on the canal in Hebden Bridge. Just follow the towpath and look out for our door.

items.title: Settle in
items.body: Bring the dog, the pram or your muddy boots. Grab a table and take a moment by the water.

items.title: Order at the counter
items.body: Choose from breakfasts, toasties and cakes baked that morning. We'll bring it over when it's ready.

items.title: Enjoy the canal
items.body: Relax with your food and drink while the water goes by. Stay as long as you like.

items.title: Baked here each morning

items.title: Hearty breakfasts
items.body: Start your day with a proper breakfast by the water. Simple, satisfying food cooked with care.

items.title: Sourdough toasties
items.body: Our sourdough toasties are made to order using good bread and simple fillings. A canalside favourite.

services.lead: A relaxed canalside café for anyone passing through or settling in for a while.

items.title: A warm welcome for all
items.body: Bring the dog, the pram or your muddy boots. Everyone's welcome at our tables by the canal.

items.question: Where exactly are you based?
items.answer: We're on the canal in Hebden Bridge. Just follow the towpath and look out for our door.

items.question: Are dogs allowed inside?
items.answer: Yes, bring the dog, the pram or your muddy boots. Everyone is welcome at Bramble and Bean.

items.question: What food do you serve?
items.answer: We serve breakfasts, sourdough toasties and cakes baked fresh each morning on site.

items.question: How do I order when I arrive?
items.answer: Just grab a table, then order at the counter. We'll bring your food over when it's ready.
